annotations.title: VAT / GST rate on a date

description: 1 call. Official VAT/GST/sales-tax rate for a country (EU 27, UK, CH, NO, IN, JP, SG, NZ, AE, Canada provinces, 22 US states) on a given date, with valid-from/to, official source link, the date we read it and a receipt id. Returns standard rate + reduced rates; it does not map products to reduced rates. Uncovered places answer status not_covered (never a guess). Example: {"country":"DE","date":"2025-03-01"}. Country names and most date formats are understood.

country.description: ISO 3166 two-letter code, e.g. DE, FR, GB, IN, SG, CA, US. 'CA-QC' / 'US-TX' style also works.

date.description: Optional: the date that matters (invoice/supply date) as YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

region.description: Optional: Canadian province (ON, QC, BC, NS...) or US state (CA, TX, NY...). US answers are the state-level rate only, no local add-ons.
